QuestInfo.name: Mystery of the Zombies
QuestInfo.1: Master Sergeant Fox is certain that there is a reason for the sudden increase in the number of zombies, and would like for you to ask Alcaster. Talk to #bAlcaster#k.
QuestInfo.2: You asked Alcaster about why the number of zombies has increased.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: EXP 32,000\n\nCan proceed to the 'Signs of Forbidden Magic' quest

0.0: We won't have to worry about Coolie Zombies for a while, thanks to you! But why did the number of zombies increase so suddenly? There were only a few in Forest of Dead Trees, and they were never a problem until now. How strange...
0.1: Perhaps we should ask Alcaster. I'll be here on the lookout for zombies while you talk to #bAlcaster#k.

no.0: I thought, of all people, you'd agree to help...

npc.0: Alcaster is inside the El Nath Market.
